description: List the schedules in your workspace, soonest next run first. Each has an id, name, description, what it starts (targetType test, map or batch, and targetId: a test config id, mapping job id or batch id), when (scheduleType once with runAt, recurring with intervalMinutes, or cron with cronExpression and timezone), enabled (the string "true" or "false"; "false" means paused), lastRunAt, nextRunAt and runCount. Takes optional `targetId`: only the schedules that start that test, mapping job or batch. Use when: the user asks what runs automatically, when something next runs, or whether a test is scheduled. Name a target with getTestConfig, getMapping or getBatch. Read-only. Needs scheduling:read.

targetId.description: Filter to schedules whose `targetId` matches this value.

name: listSchedules

items.description:
Workspace-scoped schedule. Fires via the SchedulerTrigger EventBridge rule every
minute — `nextRunAt` is recomputed on each fire and the `runCount` increments.

Pause/resume toggles `enabled` between `'true'` and `'false'` (string-typed for
DDB GSI keying; the JSON serialization reflects that string form verbatim).

cronExpression.description:
5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), required
when `scheduleType: cron`. Validated server-side.

enabled.description:
String-typed boolean (DDB GSI key constraint). `'true'` = active, `'false'` =
paused. Toggle via `pauseSchedule` / `resumeSchedule`.

eventBridgeRuleArn.description: ARN of the underlying EventBridge rule (when one is attached). Present for legacy schedules only.

eventBridgeRuleName.description: Name of the underlying EventBridge rule (when one is attached). Present for legacy schedules only.

intervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes, required when `scheduleType: recurring`.

lastRunAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent trigger. Absent until the first fire.

nextRunAt.description: Timestamp the schedule will next fire. Recomputed on each successful trigger.

runAt.description:
ISO-8601 timestamp the schedule should fire at, required when `scheduleType: once`.
Must be in the future at create-time.

runCount.description: Total number of times this schedule has been triggered.

scheduleType.description:
Trigger semantics. `once` fires at the specific `runAt` timestamp; `recurring`
fires every `intervalMinutes`; `cron` fires according to the supplied
`cronExpression` (5-field cron syntax interpreted in `timezone`).

targetId.description: Optional — target test-config id, map id, or batch id depending on `targetType`.

targetType.description:
Target kind when the schedule has a direct attachment. `test` triggers a test
run, `map` triggers a mapping job, `batch` triggers a batch dispatch. Optional —
schedules without `targetId`/`targetType` are reusable templates (handled by
downstream orchestration).

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier used to evaluate cron expressions.

title: List Schedules
